blocks.tamil_translation: went (hurriedly) to the masjid, dragging his sheet. The Sahabah gathered around him. The Prophet ﷺ led the Sahabah in two rak'ahs of Salah, and by then the eclipse had also passed. After that, Rasulullah ﷺ said, “The sun and the moon are two of the signs of Allah. An eclipse does not occur because of anyone's death (rather, just as over the other creations in the heavens and the earth, Allah exercises His control over these too. Their shining and their becoming dark is in His hands). Therefore, when an eclipse of the sun or the moon occurs, remain engaged in Salah and Du'a until the eclipse passes.” (On that very day) the death of Hazrat Ibrahim (RA), the son of Rasulullah ﷺ, took place. At that time some of the people began saying, “The eclipse occurred because of his death,” and it was for this reason that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ زَيْدِ نِ الْمَازِنِيِّ ﵁ يَقُولُ: خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ إِلَي الْمُصَلَّي فَاسْتَسْقَي وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ حِينَ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب كتاب صلاة الاستسقاء رقم:٢٠٧٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Zaid Mazini (RA) says, “Rasulullah ﷺ went to the Eidgah, and there Rasulullah ﷺ made Du'a for rain, and while facing the Qiblah he turned his sheet over, (by doing so the Prophet ﷺ indicated: may Allah likewise change our condition).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا حَزَبَهُ أَمْرٌ صَلَّي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب وقت قيام النبي ﷺ من الليل رقم:١٣١٩
